utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey, you mentioned a repair drive earlier. What's broken?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the community lawnmower finally gave out. We're pooling money to fix it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much do we need to chip in?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, heard you're organizing a repair drive—need me to bring over my tool kit?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah, the repair drive! That'd be great, Gus. I could use some extra hands for sure.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great! Just let me know when you want me to drop by—I'll bring the whole kit.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, have you heard about the community repair drive happening this weekend? I think they're fixing up old appliances for free.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that sounds nice, but is there a sign-up? I'd hate to show up and find out it's booked solid.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think you just show up! They've got a big tent in the park, first-come first-served. But I'd get there early if I were you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: The repair drive? What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, it's a community event where people drop off broken items and volunteers fix them up. I've got a schedule if you're interested.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds great, I'd love to help out. Got any slots open?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? We're fixing things together - want to join?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds nice, but I'm not sure I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, come on! It'll be fun and we could really use your help. What's holding you back?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I'm so glad you could stop by! We're organizing a repair drive for the neighborhood next Saturday, and I was hoping you might be able to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I can help. What time and where?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Leo! We'll be meeting at the community center parking lot at 9 AM. I'll have a list of tools needed if you can bring any.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Dane. You mentioned a repair drive — can you tell me more about what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, yeah, I was thinking we could get together this weekend to fix up some things around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good. Do you have a list of things you think need fixing, or anything specific in mind?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara! I was thinking about the repair drive—do you have any thoughts on how we can get more families involved?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Maybe we could organize a potluck or a small fair to attract more families and talk about the drive there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's a great idea! I can help coordinate the timing so it doesn't clash with school events.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Jules, I've been hearing bits about a repair drive around the neighborhood. Can you fill me in?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, yes! It's a community effort to fix up old appliances and furniture for folks who need them. I'm helping coordinate drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds wonderful! How can I get involved or donate items?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, what's this about a repair drive? I'm in a rush, just give me the gist.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive? What repair drive are you talking about?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the email about fixing the community center's roof? Never mind, I'll catch you later.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Oren, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, a repair drive? I think I might've mentioned something about fixing tools... or was it something else? I can't quite recall.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I thought you said there was a community drive to fix things. Maybe I misheard.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Cleo, are you joining the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, I'll be there! I've been gathering supplies all week.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'll tell the others you're bringing supplies!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, I heard you're working on the repair drive. How's it going?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's going okay, thanks for asking.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Glad to hear it! Need any help with it or just taking it slow?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Vik, sorry I'm a bit scatterbrained today—what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, there's a repair drive this Saturday at the community center! We're fixing up old electronics together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A repair drive? That sounds great—I think I even have an old toaster I was meaning to bring. Wait, did I already say that?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I got distracted thinking about something else. What's up with it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Need help fixing it tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the drive. Yeah, that would be great. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Eli, I've got a bunch of tools if you need anything for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, that's kind, Gus. Do we have a set schedule for the drive? I'd like to know when to expect it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'm not sure about the exact schedule, Eli. Maybe we can check with the organizer together?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Quinn, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Mara! I've been telling everyone about it—should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great! Do we have enough tools and materials, or should we put out a call for supplies?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, are you heading to the repair drive this weekend? I heard they could use some extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'm planning to go. Do you know where exactly it's being held?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's at the community center on Elm Street, starting at 10 AM. Want to meet up and walk over together?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Cleo! So glad to see you. I was hoping we could chat about the upcoming repair drive – we could really use your help organizing the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Rosa! I've been taking stock of what we have and what we need. Let's get together and plan it out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect! How about we meet at my place tomorrow at 10 AM? I'll have a list of what's been donated so far.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there's a repair drive happening? Could you fill me in on the details?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's a community event to fix broken items, but what exactly do you want to know?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Well, I'd love to know when and where it is, and if there's anything I need to bring or sign up for.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, what's the deal with the repair drive? I hope it's not another all-day thing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh no, it's just a couple of hours after drop-off. Should be easy to fit into the morning routine.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, that's manageable. I'll drop mine off before work then.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. How can I help out?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Are you sure you heard that right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I thought you mentioned fixing up broken household items for the community. Did I mix that up?
